premises.text: Existing transport solutions fail: developed-world EVs are slow/expensive/inefficient with limited range; developing-world bikes are unsafe, hard to drive, and impractical in rain
premises.evidence_span: these take forever to get to market. They're incredibly expensive to develop

premises.text: The C1 is a narrow enclosed electric motorcycle with car safety features (airbags, seatbelts, doors, roll cage) and car-like controls
premises.evidence_span: We made an efficient, incredibly romantic motorcycle, but with the safety and the comfort of a car

premises.text: A light platform with off-the-shelf batteries delivers long range on a small pack and uses far fewer parts for cheap manufacture and low maintenance
premises.evidence_span: because it is so light, it gets 200 miles per charge

premises.text: Dual consumer gyroscopes make the C1 self-balancing and hard to tip over, protected by filed patents
premises.evidence_span: the Lit Motor C1 is the first self-balancing, fully electric motorcycle

premises.text: Target retail pricing is about $19,000 at launch with a path to roughly $10,000 at scale and very low per-charge energy cost
premises.evidence_span: 2014 for $19,000, and we believe we can get this to scale for only $10,000 in 2017

value.text: Safe, efficient, affordable personal transportation combining motorcycle agility with car safety
value.evidence_span: safety in an accessible motorcycle that's incredibly efficient and affordable and safe

causal_links.evidence_span: we really need a new solution
the Lit Motor C1 is the first self-balancing, fully electric motorcycle
2014 for $19,000, and we believe we can get this to scale for only $10,000 in 2017
